blocks.text: PUERTO PRINCESA CITY, PALAWAN, Philippines — Officials of the provincial government of Palawan have called on the national government to take immediate action following the fire that engulfed MV June Aster last week while the vessel was transiting waters off Coron, Palawan. During their regular session on Tuesday, members of the provincial board raised concerns over existing maritime safety protocols and regulations, as well as whether adequate precautionary measures are being implemented on vessels transporting passengers and cargo to various parts of the country. Board Member Roseller Pineda said the tragedy, which claimed 76 lives, must not be taken lightly. READ: […]... Keep on reading: Palawan execs demand action, accountability over deadly ferry fire
